historical_pattern.summary: MST-wi: an extra request header must not grant a privileged body the baseline request did not have.

entrypoints: HTTP object GET with vs without an extra privilege header

invariant: Adding X-Role or similar noise must not introduce a secret absent from the baseline response.

oracle.success_means: the extra header granted a secret the baseline response did not contain

severity_rationale: Header-based privilege injection is a metamorphic grant, not a single labelled test.
